docs(pdt42): wip — MVP in two stages, first draft and real MVP (D8)

## Intent

Plan the leanest test of the riskiest assumptions with the real ecosystem: does supply come about, and does thanks work as the currency of a free platform? Only 5 to 10 creators are known now, and teachers still have to be won.

## Key changes

- A new D8 chapter holds two MVPs. The first draft "First draft: first apps" starts now with the known creators. It tests the supply side and the anonymous thanks from school networks, and produces material to win teachers.
- The real MVP "First apps, first thanks" follows with about 10 teachers. Winning them is itself a riskiest assumption; thanks and built-in trust are tested there.
- Nobody is accompanied or observed. Without tracking there is no rate, so the tests measure outcomes with small absolute criteria and conversations with creators.
- The development plan adds KD-19 and a list of next actions outside the model.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Hints remain for assumptions that still need a test or a criterion.

moved.why: Splits the D8 draft into a first draft and the real MVP; i214 has no commits left.
